summary: CorMedix Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on July 24, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey granted preliminary approval of a proposed settlement of consolidated stockholder derivative litigation (In re CorMedix Inc. Derivative Litigation, Case No. 2:21-cv-18493-JXN-LDW) and a related state court action (Raval v. Baluch). The settlement involves no monetary fund for stockholders; current stockholders as of January 19, 2026 would be bound and barred from pursuing released claims. A final settlement hearing is scheduled for September 23, 2026. The filing includes the notice and stipulation of settlement as exhibits. This is a litigation settlement disclosure, not a typical special-situation corporate event, though it resolves derivative claims and may involve corporate governance changes or fee awards. Watch for final court approval and any related governance reforms disclosed in the stipulation.
